_comment: English: the letters (pieces of regex character classes), stem_detect empty (no letter is English only: a word of none of the letters of the other packs takes this stemmer), the stemmer, the Tesseract language and stop words; lang_share: the share of the letters of a text that makes it English (an English text with more Cyrillic is taken for a mixed one); no case folding beyond lower case (fold); keep_share false: Latin is what a broken font encoding or a bad recognition turns other letters into, so its share proves nothing; no look-alike letters (homoglyphs: Latin is the side the other packs map theirs to); the dashes and quotes of its typography (read as '-' and '"' when a quote is checked); encodings: the legacy code pages of a plain-text file of the language. hyphen_suspended: the words after which a hyphen and a space end a suspended compound ('pre- and post-processing'), not a word broken at a line end.
name: English
